panasonic.title: Panasonic - Experience that turns attention into leads
panasonic.description: Immersive digital experience designed to convert event visitors into qualified leads. We combined web and virtual reality to bring the audience closer to the product, increase interaction time, and generate high-value commercial data for the sales team.
panasonic.challenge: The booth attracted visitors, but interaction with the products was superficial and did not convert into qualified leads. A striking element was missing to bring the audience closer to the technology presented.
panasonic.solution: We created a gamified web experience integrated with virtual reality glasses, transforming the product demonstration into an immersive and memorable moment. The interface was designed to collect interest data frictionlessly and guide the visitor to the next commercial step.

flytop.title: FlyTop — Global credibility with high-level performance
flytop.description: Digital brand positioning in the US market through a modern, fast, and scalable platform. The new architecture elevated the company's credibility, improved user experience, and provided a technological foundation for international growth.
flytop.challenge: The company needed to position itself in the US market with a professional, fast, and scalable platform. The Brazilian website operates differently in its approach to clients.
flytop.solution: Complete reconstruction of the architecture in React, with smart caching, API optimization, and an absolute focus on performance and user experience — aligning technology with the brand's international positioning.

wehub.title: WeHub Group — Global communication without manual effort
wehub.description: International platform with dynamic translation and content automation, designed to eliminate manual work and standardize the company's global communication. The project accelerated publications, reduced operational costs, and ensured consistency across languages.
wehub.challenge: Maintaining an international website with content in multiple languages required repetitive work, delayed publications, and caused inconsistencies between regions.
wehub.solution: Multilingual platform with instant translation, centralized content management, and market-specific automation for publishing, eliminating manual processes.

uketa.title: UK eTA — Automation and security for travel authorization
uketa.description: Digital platform designed to automate and validate UK Electronic Travel Authorization applications, reducing errors and speeding up the process for both customers and administrators.
uketa.challenge: The manual document submission process caused frequent errors, rework, and delays in application review.
uketa.solution: We built a smart step-by-step form with AI-powered image and document validation, integrated payments, and a secure admin dashboard for reviewing and approving applications.
uketa.result2: Faster and more reliable application process

faq.title: FREQUENTLY
faq.description: Get answers to your main questions about the work process.

q1.question: What's the average development timeline for a project?
q1.answer: The timeline varies according to complexity. Simple projects take 2 to 4 weeks. More robust systems can take 1 to 3 months. During the briefing, I define a detailed and realistic schedule.

q2.question: How does pricing and payment work?
q2.answer: The quote is made after detailed project analysis. I typically work with 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. For larger projects, we can split into more installments according to partial deliveries.

q3.question: Do you offer support after delivery?
q3.answer: Yes! All projects include 30 days of free support for corrections and adjustments. After that period, I offer monthly maintenance plans as needed.

q4.question: Can I follow the project development?
q4.answer: Absolutely! I maintain constant communication via Slack or WhatsApp, with weekly updates and access to the code repository. You can follow each step of the process.

q5.question: Do you work with specific technologies or are you flexible?
q5.answer: I have expertise in React, Node.js, and modern technologies, but I'm flexible to adapt to project needs. If you need a specific stack, we can discuss it.

q6.question: How do you ensure the project matches my vision?
q6.answer: Before starting the code, we create prototypes and wireframes to validate the design. During development, you follow along and can request adjustments. Approval is done at each stage.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information you provide directly, such as name, email, and messages sent through the contact form. We may also automatically collect browsing data such as IP address, browser type, and pages visited.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.content: We use your information to respond to your requests, improve our services, send relevant communications about projects and services, and comply with legal obligations when applicable.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. We use encryption and secure servers.

thirdParties.title: Third Party Sharing
thirdParties.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share data with service providers who assist us in website operations, always under confidentiality agreements.

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data. You may also withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, please contact us.

contact.title: Contact

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies on our website to improve your browsing experience.

whatAreCookies.title: What are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to recognise your device and remember your preferences and previous actions.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.description: Necessary for basic website functionality. Include session cookies and language preferences. Cannot be disabled.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.description: Help us understand how visitors interact with the site, collecting anonymous information to improve user experience.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.description: Used to track visitors across different sites and display relevant advertisements. You can opt out of these.

preferences.title: Preference Cookies
preferences.description: Allow the site to remember your choices, such as preferred language and region, to provide a personalised experience.

management.title: Cookie Management
management.content: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect site functionality.

contact.title: Questions
contact.content: If you have questions about our cookie policy, please contact us via email at contato@devfolio.com.
